review.notes: Reviewed real handler validation and independent fake routes, current React renderer mocks, sequential Android dependencies and browser lifecycle. Synthetic loopback only; retain original 31 UI checks and complete selected suites. No native/device acceptance inferred from component tests; no release/install/account changes. Measure same source/cases/environment before speed claims. CI narrowing requires proof that production cannot import affected tests. Scope proof will bind the entire Metro configuration hash and verify the actual resolver excludes test modules; unavailable or changed proof retains native checks. Self-review strengthens HQ coverage by executing workspaceHTTPRead and the production projection against an isolated store; only generated_at/since volatile clocks are fixed. Separate scheduler/process lifecycle unit assertions from installed/browser runtime layers. Review scoped HQ navigation so prepared replies cannot cross a server or session switch. Follow-up actual self-review by implementation owner34 on2026-11-07 before scene-prerequisite helper/CI migration: retain CT-HTTP and CT-SCOPE case objects. Reviewed exact650f→471 fake-serve16line source delta: bounded metadata/POST body lifecycle status and per-instance default transcript epoch; explicit world.transcripts, authorization and routes remain unchanged. Migrate its real HTTP regressions under SCENE-MIG-011. Upcoming CI adds ios-scene to relevant source selection, actualmain routing and all-required-results aggregation without branch-name exceptions, weakening existing gates or accepting skipped/missing/cancelled jobs; SCENE-MIG-009 covers the increment. This is a fresh implementation-owner review of shared mappings, not independent implementation approval or device evidence. Independent49 reviewed v2 plan only.
